title: Not what I expected
text: Not what I expected. Only fits two graments. Does not have vinyl/velcro closure at top so will not keep buggies out (clothes moth sitting on blue shows up nicely, though). Gave them away. Made well, but not what I needed (friend still had to place garments in platic bags, tape at top and rubber band at bottom to protect them). Too thin for travel.

product_metadata.title: HANGERWORLD 60" Dress Bag, Breathable Garment Bags for Storage Hanging Clothes Suit Cover (1, Blue)
features: ANY GARMENT SIZE: 60 inch long x 24 inch wide the perfect sized garment bag for hanging suits, dresses, fur coat, shirts and pants
DUST PROOF: Prevent dust, dirt and fading on your favorite clothes this dress bag with a full length zipper fully protects your clothes
LONG LASTING: High quality stitching, reinforced trim edging and strong acid free polypropylene material means these garment bags for hanging clothes will protect your clothes long term

TRAVEL: Excellent garment bags for travel, lightweight with a metal eyelet for folding the covers securely in half preventing creases to your clothes makes transporting your clothing easy and convenient
ORGANIZE: Space saving with a clear document pocket and multiple color options means you can color code and label these garment bags for closet storage organization
description: A high quality and perfectly sized suit garment bag for men to organize your closet and protect all of your garments.60 inches in length and 24 inches wide, this garment bag is ideally sized for dresses, suits, coats, jackets - you name it. Breathable non-woven polypropylene fabric is pH neutral which will protect your clothes from dusts, marking, snags and fading while acid free means that it will not decay delicate fabrics inside.Excellent for organizing your closet, these suit bags for closet storage have a labelling pocket so you do not have to unzip the cover to find your outfit. Multiple color option available means you can color code your closet storage while keeping a uniform look with identical sizes.Use and Care: To use the suit cover simply hang your clothes on a hanger, slide the hanger into the cover pulling the hanger hook through to slit at the top of the cover. If you cover gets marked simply wipe with a damp cloth. These top quality garment bags for suits are supplied by Hangerworld, a trusted British brand.
